problem.headline: Most mapping systems lose accuracy the moment you walk indoors.
problem.body: Professional 3D mapping tools are largely built indoor-first, for GPS-denied environments. That's the opposite of how autonomous vehicles are engineered — where outdoor and indoor-like conditions (tunnels, parking structures, dense urban canyons) are fused continuously, without a hard seam. We think mapping hardware should work the same way: one continuous track from the street to the stairwell.

product.headline: One sensor platform, mounted your way.
product.lead: A single hardware core — 360° LiDAR, global-shutter camera, IMU, and GNSS, writing to a hot-swappable SSD — moves between four physical mounts depending on how a site needs to be captured. Raw data is processed off-device, so the same core can serve very different workflows.

forms.title: Worn
forms.body: A stabilized frame, adapted from camera-rig design, to keep walking motion from adding noise to the scan.

forms.title: Vehicle-mounted
forms.body: The same sensor core rides on a car or cart for corridor, roadway, or site-perimeter capture at speed.

forms.title: Robot-mounted
forms.body: Fits robotic platforms for repeatable, scheduled capture in spaces that are hazardous or hard to access.

forms.title: Fixed
forms.body: Mounted in place for long-duration or before/after comparison capture of a single location.

product.note: korit.ai is in early development. The configuration shown reflects our current design direction and will evolve as hardware and field testing progress.

focus.headline: Early conversations, not a finished list.
focus.lead: We're working directly with early partners to figure out where continuous outdoor-indoor capture matters most. These are the areas we're exploring right now — if one sounds like your world, we'd like to hear how you map it today.

cards.title: Construction documentation
cards.body: As-built capture that follows a site from the yard to the fourth floor without re-anchoring.

cards.title: Infrastructure & facility surveys
cards.body: Continuous capture across mixed indoor/outdoor infrastructure — utilities, plants, campuses.

cards.title: Facility management
cards.body: Repeatable scans of the same site over time, for change tracking and space planning.

cards.title: Heritage & as-built records
cards.body: Documentation of buildings and grounds where outdoor context and interior detail both matter.

about.headline: Built by people who've mapped the world at driving speed.

cards.title: From autonomous driving to indoor mapping
cards.body: Background in SLAM algorithms, LiDAR, cameras, IMUs, and GNSS/INS sensors, with hands-on experience in sensor synchronization and calibration for autonomous vehicles — plus software and hardware project management.

cards.title: Grounding the hardware in real sites
cards.body: Civil and architecture engineering background, leading research into target use cases and the customers who'll actually carry this hardware through a building.

contact.headline: Tell us about your mapping problem.
contact.body: Whether you're evaluating mapping hardware, working in one of the areas above, or just curious what we're building — we'd like to hear from you.
